found.anchor: How not to use AI and AI tools

found.quote: Ownership (not uploading your work to non-UWL tools or giving it to other students).

Submitting work that does not have Academic Integrity: the most common form of academic misconduct is plagiarism. It can also include using ghostwriters (including AI tools), research misconduct, and exam misconduct, as well as all other kinds of cheating to gain an unfair academic advantage.
This includes published sources as well as information you may have from live case studies used in your classes and client information you may be working with.
